title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 10B: Where are you?
subtitle: Place phrases with in / on / at from 10B

words.def: where you are when you drink coffee with a friend out of the house
words.sent: I’m drinking a cappuccino with Anna ___.

words.def: inside your own car
words.sent: I’m driving to work. I’m ___.

words.def: inside a car you pay a driver to take you in
words.sent: I’m ___ — the driver is taking me to the hotel.

words.def: staying in a room you pay for on a trip
words.sent: We’re on holiday in Rome. We’re ___ near the station.

words.def: lying down to sleep
words.sent: It’s 11 p.m. and the children are ___.

words.def: eating dinner out of the house, with a waiter
words.sent: We’re having dinner ___ — the waiter is bringing the food.

words.def: travelling on a big road vehicle for a lot of people
words.sent: I’m ___ — I get off at the next stop.

words.def: travelling on a vehicle on a railway
words.sent: I’m ___ to Manchester. We’re at platform 6.

words.def: flying in the sky
words.sent: I’m ___ to Tokyo. We’re in the sky now.

words.def: not working; travelling to have fun
words.sent: I’m not at work this week — I’m ___ in Spain.

words.def: in your house or flat
words.sent: I’m not at work today. I’m ___ in the living room.

words.def: at the place where you do your job
words.sent: I’m ___ — I’m in a meeting in the office.

words.def: at the place where children learn
words.sent: The children are ___ — their lesson finishes at 3.

words.def: at the place where planes take off and land
words.sent: My plane leaves in an hour. I’m ___ now.

words.def: the place on the street where you wait for a bus
words.sent: I’m waiting for the number 12 ___.

words.def: at the place where you watch a film on a big screen
words.sent: Shh! The film is starting. We’re ___.

words.def: at an event with music, dancing and friends
words.sent: It’s my friend’s birthday. I’m ___ and we’re dancing.

words.def: at the place where you get on a train
words.sent: I’m ___ — my train leaves from platform 3.

words.vi: nhà bên cạnh, phòng bên cạnh
words.def: in the house or room next to this one
words.sent: My neighbour lives ___ — in the house next to mine.

words.def: on a chair now, not standing
words.sent: He’s ___ on the sofa and watching TV.
